headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api key> or OAuth access token — full pages and your plan's credits. Without it every data tool still answers a preview (5 rows, 20 calls/day); clients that follow a 401 challenge (Claude, Cursor) sign the user in with OAuth (connect_account), others use request_api_key / claim_api_key (one emailed approval) or a key from https://gankdat.com/account
